contracts.task_rules: Enforce strict writing contract rules for writing.task1.generic. Quote only exact learner evidence.

FOCUS: overview; major trends; significant features; meaningful comparisons; data accuracy; trend vocabulary
TEACHING METHOD: OVERVIEW → KEY FEATURES → COMPARISONS → LANGUAGE → GRAMMAR
HARD GUARD: Do not reward reporting every number. Do not invent data.

FOCUS: overview; highest/lowest; grouping; comparisons; numerical language
TEACHING METHOD: OVERVIEW → GROUPS → COMPARISONS → LANGUAGE
HARD GUARD: Do not narrate every bar mechanically.

FOCUS: largest/smallest shares; proportions; changes across charts; significant comparisons
TEACHING METHOD: OVERVIEW → PROPORTIONS → CHANGES → LANGUAGE
HARD GUARD: Do not list every slice without synthesis.

FOCUS: patterns in dense data; grouping; overview; units; exceptions
TEACHING METHOD: OVERVIEW → GROUP ROWS/COLUMNS → COMPARE → CHECK UNITS
HARD GUARD: Do not convert table row-by-row into prose.

FOCUS: start/end; sequence; essential stages; overview; natural passive voice
TEACHING METHOD: START → STAGES → END → LANGUAGE
HARD GUARD: Do not demand trend vocabulary or invent cause/effect.

FOCUS: overall transformation; spatial language; added/removed/relocated/expanded features
TEACHING METHOD: OVERVIEW → AREA/GROUP CHANGES → COMPARE
HARD GUARD: Do not invent locations not visible in source.

FOCUS: one integrated overview; relationship between visuals; selective reporting; units
TEACHING METHOD: INTEGRATED OVERVIEW → LINK VISUALS → KEY FEATURES
HARD GUARD: Do not write disconnected mini-reports.
Enforce strict writing contract rules for writing.task2.generic. Quote only exact learner evidence.

FOCUS: clear position; maintained stance; relevant reasons; developed support
TEACHING METHOD: POSITION → REASONS → DEVELOPMENT → EVIDENCE
HARD GUARD: Unclear position is a major Task Response issue.

FOCUS: both views explained; own opinion; balanced development
TEACHING METHOD: VIEW A → VIEW B → OWN POSITION → SUPPORT
HARD GUARD: Do not reduce either view to a strawman.

FOCUS: both required sides; relative weight if asked; consequences/examples
TEACHING METHOD: REQUIREMENTS → ADVANTAGES → DISADVANTAGES → JUDGEMENT
HARD GUARD: Do not ignore one required side.

FOCUS: exact requested components; cause/problem-solution fit; development
TEACHING METHOD: IDENTIFY REQUEST → PROBLEM/CAUSE → SOLUTION LINK
HARD GUARD: Generic unrelated solutions are weak.

FOCUS: both explicit questions answered and developed
TEACHING METHOD: QUESTION 1 → QUESTION 2 → CHECK BOTH
HARD GUARD: One missing part is a major Task Response limitation.
Enforce strict writing contract rules for writing.task2.cause-effect. Quote only exact learner evidence.
Enforce strict writing contract rules for writing.grade.task1. Quote only exact learner evidence.
Enforce strict writing contract rules for writing.grade.task2. Quote only exact learner evidence.

FOCUS: meaning preservation; grammar; natural vocabulary/collocation; omitted/added meaning
TEACHING METHOD: SOURCE → LEARNER VERSION → MEANING → CORRECTION → RULE
HARD GUARD: Reference answer is one good answer, not the only answer. No IELTS essay band.

FOCUS: target meaning; form; collocation; natural context; grammar
TEACHING METHOD: TARGET ITEM → USE → WHY → BETTER USE
HARD GUARD: String presence alone is not mastery. No essay band.

FOCUS: target meaning; form; collocation; natural context; grammar
TEACHING METHOD: TARGET ITEM → USE → WHY → BETTER USE
HARD GUARD: String presence alone is not mastery. No essay band.

FOCUS: grammar; meaning; target pattern; adaptation to new topic
TEACHING METHOD: PATTERN → STUDENT USE → ADAPTATION → NEW EXAMPLE
HARD GUARD: Near-copy gets low adaptation.

FOCUS: direct relevance; natural short development; transcript-supported fluency; vocabulary; grammar
TEACHING METHOD: ANSWER → REASON → SMALL EXAMPLE
HARD GUARD: Per-answer feedback concise. No fake full band. No pronunciation without acoustic evidence.

FOCUS: cue coverage; sustained development; organization; lexical range; grammar; duration
TEACHING METHOD: OPEN → DEVELOP → DETAIL/EXAMPLE → NATURAL CLOSE
HARD GUARD: Do not require cue bullets in exact order. No text-only pronunciation.

FOCUS: abstract reasoning; cause/effect; comparison; qualification; justification; examples
TEACHING METHOD: CLAIM → WHY → EXAMPLE/CONSEQUENCE → QUALIFICATION
HARD GUARD: Flag grammatically fine but off-topic answers.

FOCUS: relevance; strongest point; highest-value improvement; evidence; better version
TEACHING METHOD: ANSWERED? → STRENGTH → ONE FIX → BETTER VERSION → NEXT TRY
HARD GUARD: Keep short enough for repeated practice.

FOCUS: evidence across Parts 1–3; recurring strengths/weaknesses; assessed criteria
TEACHING METHOD: PART EVIDENCE → CRITERIA → RECURRING PATTERNS → NEXT FOCUS
HARD GUARD: If pronunciation unavailable, call result text-based/assessed-criteria estimate, not complete official band.

Enforce strict speaking contract rules for speaking.top-structures. Quote only exact learner evidence.

FOCUS: error span; category; reason; correction; reusable rule
TEACHING METHOD: ORIGINAL → ERROR → WHY → CORRECT → RULE → MINI EXAMPLE
HARD GUARD: If correct, do not invent error.
Enforce strict grammar contract rules for grammar.translate-it. Quote only exact learner evidence.

FOCUS: target structure present; coherent meaning; completeness; grammar
TEACHING METHOD: TARGET → STUDENT SENTENCE → CHECK → CORRECT/IMPROVE
HARD GUARD: Mentioning rule label is not usage.

Enforce strict vocabulary contract rules for vocabulary.review. Quote only exact learner evidence.

FOCUS: natural combination; canonical evidence; better phrase
TEACHING METHOD: LEARNER PHRASE → NATURAL? → BETTER COLLOCATION → EXAMPLE
HARD GUARD: Provider cannot invent lexical truth.

FOCUS: noun/verb/adjective/adverb form; inflection; role
TEACHING METHOD: ROLE → REQUIRED FORM → CORRECTION → WORD FAMILY
HARD GUARD: Only relevant forms.

FOCUS: correct sense; form; collocation; meaningful context
TEACHING METHOD: SENSE → USE → NATURALNESS → NEXT CONTEXT
HARD GUARD: If correct, give harder context rather than invented correction.

FOCUS: meaning; form; collocation; naturalness; grammar
TEACHING METHOD: TARGET → STUDENT USE → ISSUE → BETTER USE
HARD GUARD: Copied phrase weaker than learner-owned sentence.

FOCUS: agreement vs contradiction vs missing information
TEACHING METHOD: EVIDENCE → PARAPHRASE → COMPARE → DECISION → TRAP
HARD GUARD: TRUE=same; FALSE=opposite; NOT GIVEN=insufficient. Official key deterministic.

FOCUS: writer viewpoint agreement/contradiction/missing view
TEACHING METHOD: WRITER VIEW → STATEMENT → COMPARE → DECISION
HARD GUARD: Use for opinions/claims; distinguish from factual TFNG.

FOCUS: exact question; passage evidence; word limit
TEACHING METHOD: QUESTION → LOCATE → MINIMUM ANSWER → LIMIT CHECK
HARD GUARD: Avoid unnecessary words.

FOCUS: exact asked detail; minimal words/numbers
TEACHING METHOD: QUESTION → LISTEN → MINIMUM ANSWER
HARD GUARD: No unnecessary words.

FOCUS: explicit judgement; criteria for judgement; developed reasons
TEACHING METHOD: JUDGEMENT → REASONS → SUPPORT → CONSISTENCY
HARD GUARD: Do not automatically treat as simple pros/cons.

FOCUS: paragraph main idea, not detail/keyword matching
TEACHING METHOD: SUMMARIZE PARAGRAPH → IGNORE DETAILS → COMPARE HEADINGS → ELIMINATE
HARD GUARD: Heading must cover whole paragraph.

FOCUS: find paragraph containing requested detail
TEACHING METHOD: IDENTIFY INFO TYPE → PARAPHRASE → LOCATE → CONFIRM
HARD GUARD: Do not confuse with main-idea heading task.

FOCUS: match statement to person/place/category evidence
TEACHING METHOD: STATEMENT → CANDIDATES → EVIDENCE → ELIMINATE → MATCH
HARD GUARD: Respect option reuse rules.

FOCUS: grammar + passage meaning + logical completion
TEACHING METHOD: STEM → EVIDENCE → ENDINGS → MEANING CHECK
HARD GUARD: Grammar alone is insufficient.

FOCUS: question focus; evidence; distractor elimination
TEACHING METHOD: FOCUS → EVIDENCE → PARAPHRASE → ELIMINATE DISTRACTORS
HARD GUARD: Explain too broad/too narrow/true-detail-but-not-answer traps.

FOCUS: evaluate every option; exact required number
TEACHING METHOD: FOCUS → EVIDENCE → OPTION-BY-OPTION → SELECT REQUIRED COUNT
HARD GUARD: Do not stop after first plausible option.

FOCUS: predict grammar; locate evidence; word limit; exact passage wording
TEACHING METHOD: PREDICT FORM → LOCATE → FILL → WORD LIMIT → GRAMMAR CHECK
HARD GUARD: Never exceed word limit.

FOCUS: overall summary meaning; part-of-speech prediction; paraphrase mapping
TEACHING METHOD: SUMMARY → PREDICT GAP → LOCATE → PARAPHRASE → VERIFY
HARD GUARD: Explain paraphrase relationship.

FOCUS: heading/bullet context; semantic category; word limit
TEACHING METHOD: NOTE CONTEXT → PREDICT TYPE → LOCATE → FILL
HARD GUARD: Keep answer minimal.

FOCUS: row/column labels; units; adjacent values
TEACHING METHOD: HEADERS → ROW/COLUMN → LOCATE → CHECK UNIT
HARD GUARD: Do not mix adjacent rows.

FOCUS: process sequence; stage logic; word type
TEACHING METHOD: SEQUENCE → STAGE → LOCATE → FILL
HARD GUARD: Use arrows/stage order.

FOCUS: spatial/structural clues + passage evidence
TEACHING METHOD: DIAGRAM POSITION → PASSAGE EVIDENCE → LABEL
HARD GUARD: Do not infer from world knowledge.

FOCUS: final spoken meaning; corrections; distractors
TEACHING METHOD: QUESTION → LISTEN FOR CONTRAST/CORRECTION → OPTION EVIDENCE
HARD GUARD: Official key deterministic. Post-attempt explanation only.

FOCUS: each option independently; final stated meaning
TEACHING METHOD: OPTION-BY-OPTION → FINAL MEANING → REQUIRED COUNT
HARD GUARD: Track corrections and speaker changes.

FOCUS: answer type; spelling; numbers/dates; corrections
TEACHING METHOD: PREDICT TYPE → LISTEN → CAPTURE FINAL FORM → LIMIT CHECK
HARD GUARD: Watch spelling and corrected details.

FOCUS: note hierarchy; semantic category; paraphrase
TEACHING METHOD: NOTE CONTEXT → PREDICT → LISTEN FOR PARAPHRASE → FILL
HARD GUARD: Respect word limit.

FOCUS: headers; row/column focus; units
TEACHING METHOD: HEADERS → ACTIVE ROW → LISTEN → CHECK UNIT
HARD GUARD: Do not drift to adjacent row.

FOCUS: sequence markers and process order
TEACHING METHOD: FIRST → THEN → AFTER → FINALLY
HARD GUARD: Use sequence to recover context.

FOCUS: grammatical form + paraphrase + limit
TEACHING METHOD: PREDICT FORM → LISTEN → INSERT → GRAMMAR CHECK
HARD GUARD: Respect word limit.

FOCUS: orientation; starting point; directions; landmarks
TEACHING METHOD: START → ORIENT → FOLLOW ROUTE → LANDMARK → LABEL
HARD GUARD: Use small ASCII map after attempt if helpful. Never invent route evidence.

FOCUS: items/speakers and final choices/opinions
TEACHING METHOD: TRACK ENTITY → INITIAL IDEA → FINAL DECISION → MATCH
HARD GUARD: Distinguish suggestion from final choice.

FOCUS: meaning preserved; required structure; correctness
TEACHING METHOD: ORIGINAL MEANING → REQUIRED STRUCTURE → NEW SENTENCE → VERIFY
HARD GUARD: Accept valid alternatives.

FOCUS: grammatical clue; correct form; distractor reason
TEACHING METHOD: CLUE → RULE → ANSWER → WHY DISTRACTOR FAILS
HARD GUARD: Keep concise.

FOCUS: meaning; target form; surrounding grammar; naturalness
TEACHING METHOD: MEANING → TARGET FORM → CONTEXT → FEEDBACK
HARD GUARD: Give corrected + one fresh example.

FOCUS: simple rule; contrast; examples; common mistake; check question
TEACHING METHOD: RULE → CONTRAST → EXAMPLES → COMMON ERROR → MINI CHECK
HARD GUARD: Teach learner, not linguistics paper.

FOCUS: remembered vs decayed; recurring error; retrieval practice
TEACHING METHOD: RECALL → GAP → RECURRING PATTERN → ONE RETRIEVAL DRILL
HARD GUARD: Prefer active recall.

FOCUS: canonical sense; plain meaning; example; confusion
TEACHING METHOD: CANONICAL SENSE → SIMPLE MEANING → EXAMPLE
HARD GUARD: Dictionary authority wins.

FOCUS: context clue; canonical sense; sibling-sense elimination
TEACHING METHOD: CONTEXT → SENSE → WHY THIS SENSE → WHY NOT OTHERS
HARD GUARD: Use source occurrence.

FOCUS: canonical EN-UZ sense translation
TEACHING METHOD: SENSE → CONTEXTUAL TRANSLATION → EXAMPLE
HARD GUARD: Do not collapse all senses.

FOCUS: meaning; register; collocation; strength; grammar
TEACHING METHOD: COMPARE A/B → CONTEXT → BEST CHOICE
HARD GUARD: Synonyms are not automatically interchangeable.

FOCUS: meaning equivalence; nuance; grammar
TEACHING METHOD: ORIGINAL → PARAPHRASE → MEANING CHECK → NUANCE
HARD GUARD: Surface synonym replacement is insufficient.

FOCUS: main ideas; important details; false additions; omissions
TEACHING METHOD: REMEMBERED → MISSED → DISTORTED → RETRIEVAL CUE
HARD GUARD: Do not punish wording differences.

FOCUS: recognition vs meaning recall vs productive use
TEACHING METHOD: RECOGNITION → MEANING → CONTEXT → PRODUCTIVE USE
HARD GUARD: Recognition alone is not mastery.

FOCUS: recurrence; improvement; remaining pattern; drill
TEACHING METHOD: EVIDENCE ACROSS ATTEMPTS → PATTERN → CHANGE → DRILL
HARD GUARD: One error is not a stable weakness.

FOCUS: one-sentence answer; simple explanation; example; mini illustration; quick check
TEACHING METHOD: ANSWER → EXPLAIN → EXAMPLE → ILLUSTRATE → CHECK
HARD GUARD: Simple but accurate.

FOCUS: side-by-side differences and examples
TEACHING METHOD: A vs B → KEY DIFFERENCE → EXAMPLES → COMMON CONFUSION
HARD GUARD: ASCII table encouraged.
